title: When on DASH history view, AAPS crash/restart when rotating the phone
body:
**AndroidAPS 2.8.2.8-dev**
Build: 8fe7e7ce2
Flavor: fulldebug

**Problem description:**
When on DASH history view,
AAPS crash/restarts when rotating between portrait<->landscape mode (rotating the phone)
